mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates rapidly.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 5d SPX returns > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic momentum slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE signals monetary policy easing in response to labor market weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stimulus expectations boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS*UNRATE and 20d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO signals broad-based economic weakness in consumer and industrial sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate rapidly.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST*INDPRO and 5d SPX returns > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high GDP growth and low unemployment), S&P 500 underperforms over the next 60 trading days due to rising inflation expectations and anticipated monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when GDPC1 > 15000 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (high retail sales and housing starts), S&P 500 underperforms over the next 20 trading days due to inflation fears and premature monetary tightening expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 900.
